workunit: SPEC-038 CMS verified fact age metric and distribution
scope: Tenant-scoped median verified age and age distribution, dashboard states, structured data issues, JSON-LD processing and CMS skill-output regressions

acceptance.median: Returns median days since lastVerifiedAt; displays an em dash when no artifacts are verified.
acceptance.distribution: Shows 0-7, 8-30, 31-90, over-90-day and unverified counts as age bands.
acceptance.data_authority: Uses existing content_artifacts.lastVerifiedAt, which saveArtifact and refreshArtifact already write.
acceptance.authorization: Computed through the existing admin-only, tenant-filtered contentQuality.getOverview query.

resource_observation.reason: Focused package tests completed in under two seconds; no memory-heavy profile was run.

notes: This is a last-verified age proxy for CMS artifacts, not an external fact-correctness audit. SPEC-038 remains partial.
